paper_id: FSL_ federated sequential learning-based cyberattack detection for Industrial Internet of Things
title: FSL: federated sequential learning-based cyberattack detection for Industrial Internet of Things
motivation: IIoT faces data isolation and node heterogeneity challenges for cyberattack detection while preserving data security
problem_framing: 分布式节点时间序列数据的异构性导致全局模型精度下降,需要协同建模但不暴露原始数据
key_insight: TCN提取局部时序特征+FedProx正则化聚合,可解决节点异构和时间序列建模的双重挑战
method_signature: TCN本地模型+FedProx联邦聚合的时序攻击检测框架
evaluation_criteria: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 score对比CNN/LSTM
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: VSA和UA攻击因对时序信号影响小而检测效果差;实验中只有4个客户端,节点异构性不够明显
evidence_for_taste: non-i.i.d. characteristics may lead to a severe impairment
CNN performs much better on MNIST
FSL loss function converged faster and gave the best results
the models tend to confuse VSA and UA with normal signals
making the heterogeneity of nodes not obvious enough
thinking_moves: 时序数据的本质是因果依赖,用TCN的膨胀卷积捕获长距离时序关联
FedProx通过近端项约束本地更新偏移,缓解非i.i.d.数据导致的client-drift
先证明时序模型对工业数据有效,再迁移到联邦框架验证可行性
实验设计用MNIST排除时序假设,用BDD验证时序建模,用Edge-IIoTset验证真实IIoT攻击检测
cites_own_work: Li F, Li Q, Zhang J, et al. (2021) detection and diagnosis of data integrity attacks in solar farms
Zhao L, Li J, Li Q, Li F (2022) federated learning framework for detecting false data injection attacks
